meta.name: hybrid-cloud-networking
meta.description: Configure secure, high-performance connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and cloud platforms using VPN and dedicated connections. Use when building hybrid cloud architectures, connecting data centers to cloud, or implementing secure cross-premises networking.

copy.tagline: 构建本地与云端的安全连接通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在本地数据中心与云平台间建立安全连接
copy.tagline_en: Connect your on-premises data center to cloud securely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish secure connectivity between on-premises and cloud.

howto.what: 根据混合云网络需求,Claude会给出VPN或专线(如Direct Connect、ExpressRoute等)的配置方案,生成对应的Terraform代码,并说明路由、安全与高可用设置。
howto.when: 用户在构建混合云架构、连接数据中心到云或需要跨地点安全网络时触发。

say.text: 帮我配置一条从本地数据中心到AWS的Site-to-Site VPN。
say.note: 会生成VPN网关和连接的HCL代码。

say.text: 我要搭一个多区域混合云,让本地同时连到AWS和Azure。
say.note: 会按多云混合模式给出架构和配置步骤。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude configures site-to-site VPN or dedicated links (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, etc.) across AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI, providing Terraform code, architecture patterns, routing, security, and monitoring guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when building hybrid cloud architectures, connecting data centers to cloud, or implementing secure cross-premises networking.

say_en.text: Help me set up a Site-to-Site VPN from my on-premises datacenter to AWS.
say_en.note: Generates gateway and connection Terraform config.

say_en.text: Compare Azure ExpressRoute and Site-to-Site VPN for a hybrid design.
say_en.note: Lists bandwidth, latency, and cost differences.

say_en.text: I need a multi-region hybrid with on-prem connected to both AWS and Azure.
say_en.note: Provides a pattern with configuration steps.
